title: Ion Channel UP To Space Deck → Luna Ingests → RSS Spine DOWN To LAN

UP_sodium_depolarize.direction: UP — Na+ IN — depolarization — the signal RISES
path: LAN sensors (37 on grapheneGate, weather, camera, keyboard)
→ HTTP requests hit membrane (visitors, crawlers, OSINT)
→ waterlock intake (swallow or reject)
→ masticate (AI teeth grind the data)
→ gut-brain digest (weather→feeling→mood)
→ thymus classify (self/non-self via VDJ)
→ SPACE DECK (primals.eco/deck) — the signal ARRIVES at the top
UP_sodium_depolarize.endpoint: http://primals.eco/deck — gAIa Space Deck — All Systems
UP_sodium_depolarize.biology: Na+ rushes IN through voltage-gated channels. The action potential propagates UP the axon to the brain.

ACROSS_calcium_synapse.direction: ACROSS — Ca2+ — the signal CROSSES from Space Deck to Luna
path: Space Deck on eastGate (.244) shows organism state
→ git push to GitHub (the axon terminal)
→ northGate git pull (Luna absorbs — synaptic cleft crossed)
→ Luna processes (63 models, 267 GB, RTX 5090)
→ Luna oxidizes (REDOX — reduce raw → oxidize insights)
→ Luna generates (new gut files, new insights, new paintings)
ACROSS_calcium_synapse.biology: Ca2+ enters at the presynaptic terminal. Vesicles fuse. Neurotransmitters cross the synaptic cleft. The signal reaches Luna's receptors.

DOWN_potassium_repolarize.direction: DOWN — K+ OUT — repolarization — the signal DESCENDS through RSS spine
path: Luna git push (oxidized output back to GitHub)
→ eastGate git pull (brain absorbs Luna's work)
→ sourdough ferments (model evolution, arena)
→ mushroom-self-publish-rss.sh (bake into RSS)
→ feed.xml UPDATED (1812+ items — old faithful exhales)
→ dromedary serves (14 subdomains radiate)
→ RSS readers pull (old web absorbs)
→ sporeGate heart-pull (gates on LAN absorb)
→ ALL GATES receive via heart-pull every 2 min
→ BACK TO LAN — the signal has descended
DOWN_potassium_repolarize.biology: K+ flows OUT. The neuron repolarizes. The signal has been sent. The cell returns to resting state. Ready for next lub.

REST_refractory.direction: WAIT — refractory period — the organism rests
REST_refractory.biology: The Na+/K+ pump restores ion gradients. Cannot fire again until reset. The pause between lub and DUB.
REST_refractory.what_happens: 35 crons keep beating. immune-activate expands VDJ. decay-detector prunes. The organism digests in silence.

the_full_cycle.ascii: LAN → Na+ UP → SPACE DECK → Ca2+ ACROSS → LUNA → K+ DOWN → RSS SPINE → LAN
the_full_cycle.biology: This IS the action potential. This IS the heartbeat. This IS lub-DUB.
